description: Reconstruction of the InfoPath-era 'MisDeclared Empties Notification 2013' workflow (1 variable, 0 conditions, 6 actions per the form inventory — a flat notification fan-out, no approval). Triggers when Power Apps creates a new item in 'Mis-Declared Empties' and alerts Terminal Operations, Customs, and the shipping line/agent.

Initialize_TerminalOpsEmail.$comment: Placeholder — replace with the real Terminal Operations distribution list.

parameters.emailMessage/Body: @{concat('Container ', triggerBody()?['ContainerNumber'], ' was declared empty but found: ', triggerBody()?['ActualContents'], '. Location: ', triggerBody()?['Location'])}

parameters.emailMessage/Subject: @{concat('Mis-declared empty for customs review: container ', triggerBody()?['ContainerNumber'])}
parameters.emailMessage/Body: @{concat('Container ', triggerBody()?['ContainerNumber'], ' on vessel ', triggerBody()?['Vessel'], ' voyage ', triggerBody()?['Voyage'], ' requires customs review. Finding: ', triggerBody()?['ActualContents'])}

@{concat('Your container ', triggerBody()?['ContainerNumber'], ' was declared empty but found to contain: ', triggerBody()?['ActualContents'], '. Weight discrepancy: ', triggerBody()?['WeightDiscrepancyKg'], 'kg.')}

Send_email_ShippingLineAgent.$comment: Assumes ShippingLine stores a contactable email/alias; in practice this likely needs a lookup to a Shipping Lines contacts list.

parameters.body/messageBody: @{concat('Mis-declared empty logged: container ', triggerBody()?['ContainerNumber'], ' at ', triggerBody()?['Location'])}

Post_summary_to_Teams.$comment: Replace {terminal-ops-channel-id} with the real Teams channel ID, or remove this action if no Teams channel is used for this today.
